Run every command from delivery/review-delivery-contract.json in exact order after deterministic npm ci.

Open one stacked SD-007 pull request against work/sd-006-release-communication.

Prove one controlled failing revision is blocked, then prove the corrected exact revision is green without weakening the gate.
Analyse the actual trace through one quarantined Prime candidate, independent evaluation, exact human decision, and at most one non-mutating promotion packet.

Merging SignalDesk PR #4, the SD-007 PR, or Elder PR #6.
Staging, production, application deployment, release, rollback, P5.2 activation, L3, or canary work.
